reason: It's on my dog-walk route and they name the grade and farm and let me taste the plain matcha for free, so I can check the quality before paying. If the sip is good I'll grab a plain matcha latte on the way back a few times, but I'll skip the cheesecake and cherry pie stuff.
objection: No reviews yet, and places that lead with dessert-flavored matcha usually use cheap, sweetened powder. I already have spots I trust, so it has to actually taste better.
would_change_my_mind: If the free sip tastes like bitter culinary-grade powder, I won't come back.
